description: Read-only fulfillment eligibility, price and delivery details for one exact product, ZIP, quantity and local_delivery or ship_to_home mode. The response contains no source-shop details. An available local_delivery result verifies same-day eligibility for that context. A failed check means unknown eligibility, not unavailable.
name: get_buying_options

available.description: True only when the requested mode was verified as orderable for this exact product, ZIP and quantity.

delivery_promise.description: "Get it today" (local_delivery) or "Ships to you" (ship_to_home) when available.

quote.description: The price an agent may state before checkout: unit price x quantity + the flat fee for the mode = total (before sales tax, which checkout adds). Null when the price could not be read; reason_code says why.

eta.description: same_day for local delivery; a display-only date window for ship_to_home. Null when no window is known.

total.description: subtotal + fee before tax; null when the fee could not be read.

reason_code.description: Present when available is false: why this mode cannot be bought here now.

ship_estimate.description: Display-only arrival window for a shipped order. An estimate, not a promise.

shipping_price.description: USD, e.g. "$7.99". The flat shipping fee for this order, present only on an offer the storefront can sell (an offer that ships from JENNi) when a fee is set. Absent means unstated, never free. Added at checkout on top of `price`.

color.description: Colour of the variant product_id names; null when it has none.

description.description: Product description from the source catalog, when returned.

offers.description: JENNi's single best offer for this product (price, delivery_promise, fulfilled_by, is_eligible_checkout), without source-shop details.

availability.description: NULL when we have no shelf read under 24 hours old (shelf_observed_at says when). Null is not evidence of in-stock or out-of-stock state; checkout eligibility is independent.

delivery_promise.description: Shopper-facing delivery promise, e.g. "Get it today" (local delivery) or "Ships to you".

fulfillment.description: `local_delivery`: delivered the same day by JENNi. `ship_to_home`: shipped to the shopper by JENNi. `in_store_only`: observed, but it cannot be ordered through JENNi for this destination. These are not executable MCP methods: ordering happens on the storefront.

is_eligible_checkout.description: True when this offer is currently eligible for ordering through JENNi; false otherwise. Eligibility and price are checked again at hosted checkout. Nothing is charged until the buyer places the order on the checkout page.

price.description: USD, e.g. "$12.50". Null when we hold no current price.

product_id.description: The exact variant this offer covers.

shelf_observed_at.description: When the shelf was last read. Null means never.

shelf_price.description: Observed shelf price for browsing, not a checkout price. Purchase price and checkout eligibility are separate fields.

ship_estimate.description: Display-only arrival window for a shipped order. An estimate, not a promise.

shipping_label.description: Plain-language label for shipping_price, e.g. "$7.99 flat shipping".

shipping_price.description: USD, e.g. "$7.99". The flat shipping fee for this order, present only on an offer the storefront can sell (an offer that ships from JENNi) when a fee is set. Absent means unstated, never free. Added at checkout on top of `price`.

url.description: Storefront page for this exact product.

price.description: Headline price in USD; null when none is held.

reason_code.description: Present when offers is empty: not_checked (no fulfillment mode was verified for this result) or not_served_locally.

shelf_price.description: Observed shelf price for browsing, not a checkout price. Purchase price and checkout eligibility are separate fields.

size.description: Size of the variant product_id names; null when it has none.

url.description: Storefront product page, where the buyer picks size/colour, checks out as a guest (email, no account) and pays. Null when no storefront is configured.

variants.description: Buyable size/colour variants and their product URLs. Search responses contain at most 30; detail responses may include all variants.

url.description: Storefront page opened on this variant.

title: Check price and delivery
